page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9gc.64xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors. It features 256 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, paired with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance integrates eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, providing a total of 576 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 380 Gbps. However, the instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions, and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and dedicated AMD EPYC processors, this instance represents a high-tier hardware class optimized for massive parallel processing. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for external data volumes. It is designed for workloads such as large language model training, complex data science jobs, distributed machine learning, and high-throughput GPU-accelerated computing.
